title: JADE: A Linguistics-based Safety Evaluation Platform for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applying targeted linguistic fuzzing (generative and transformational grammatical rules) to increase the syntactic complexity of seed questions with prejudiced intentions, and measuring the unsafe generation ratio of the language models.
